d:
Suji aur aalu se banaen ekdam kurkure aur testi instent vare! jhatpat banne vala yah nashta barish ke mausam, subah ke brekphast ya sham ki chay ke sath parosne ke lie. achanak mehman aa jaen ya barish men kuchh chatapta aur kurkura khane ka man kare to ye bilkul parphekt nashta hai. sath men parosiye mungaphli aur chana dal ki tikhi aur svadisht chatni, jo iske svad ko aur bhi barha deti hai.
Crispy Sooji Vada (Rava Medu Vada) at home with step-by-step instructions. This instant vada recipe is made using suji, boiled potatoes, and spices, served with a delicious homemade chutney.
